يستهدوا (form X)
# يَسْتَهْدُوا (yastahdū) /jas.tah.duː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
# يُسْتَهْدَوْا (yustahdaw) /jus.tah.daw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَهْدَى (istahdā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
